agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The automatic reviewer incorrectly called Vacuum Wave suboptimal solely because fresh Fake Out was also legal.
findings.observed_fact: Ponyta had 2 HP; both moves guaranteed the KO, and Vacuum Wave had the higher verified minimum damage.

resolution.observed: Removed the Fake-Out-specific review assertion. The existing lexicographic dominance check remains, and the regression now rejects promotion of a weaker Fake Out.

findings.summary: Lildozer, Croakatoa, and Coppertop fainted, but each made required progress before a forced replacement; monitor whether later clones preserve more without weakening reliability.
The verified win used 23 actions and 5 switches; only the Ponyta and Sunflora matchup entries were voluntary.

correct_choices: Vacuum Wave immediately removed the 2-HP Ponyta and then chipped Eelektrik twice before Croakatoa's critical-hit faint.
Bushtank entered only after a forced faint, removed Eelektrik in three Razor Leafs, and was preserved at 7 HP.
Coppertop was the only switch certified to survive Sunflora's entry hit; it reduced Sunflora to 21 HP before Birdlaw's forced entry.
Birdlaw then removed Sunflora and Dustox without switching, leaving three authoritative survivors.
No voluntary replacement entered and left without executing a move.
agent_review.next_test: Run Clone 2 with the identical behavior and require another win with no no-action voluntary switch or new action-changing defect.
